Wyrdeer

Normal Psychic

Galar · Generation 8

Wyrdeer is a Normal/Psychic-type Big Horn Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 1.8 m tall and weighs 95.1 kg. It evolves from Stantler. Its highest base stat is Attack (105), with a base stat total of 525.
